backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining all core types and persistent maps for tasks, notes, timers, profiles, rewards, and related study-app data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two icon‑related features, their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping many frontend component paths to short functional summaries for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with app title and links to cache-safe v4 Scholar Gold icons plus script bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app coordinating authentication, profile setup, notifications, and tabbed navigation for all major sections.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: UI component for purchasing, uploading, or capturing custom or AI‑generated backgrounds with coin checks and preview logic.
frontend/src/components/DailyGoalProgres: Displays and edits the user's daily study goal and shows progress based on today's completed study minutes.
frontend/src/components/DailySyllabusRem: Triggers a daily reminder notification after 8 PM if no syllabus items are checked off.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the app header with theme toggle, user authentication controls, and profile avatar.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Presents the login page with feature highlights and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyStudySumm: Displays monthly study stats, including total minutes and best 7‑day period, with month navigation.
frontend/src/components/NoteLinker.tsx: Allows linking, unlinking, or creating notes to associate with another item via dialogs.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Manages creating, editing, and deleting notes with text, images, and voice recordings using backend mutations and UI dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: Displays and edits user profile info, including bio, display name, profile image, coins, streak, and level progress.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial setup dialog for entering a display name and bio and creating the user profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Schedules and displays browser notifications for upcoming reminders, tracking notified items in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: Allows users to create, edit, link to notes, and delete reminders with date and time validation.
frontend/src/components/RewardShopSectio: Renders a coin‑based shop where users can preview and purchase cosmetic items like avatar frames, badges, and themes.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Implements a persistent stopwatch with backend-synced state, restoration logic, and UI controls for start, pause, and reset.
frontend/src/components/StudyHeatmapView: Generates a 90‑day heatmap of completed study sessions with intensity coloring and tooltips.
frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerS: Manages syllabus subjects and subtopics with local storage, dialogs for editing, and exam countdown tracking.
frontend/src/components/TaskCompletionHe: Builds a 90‑day heatmap of completed tasks using aggregated completion counts and tooltip‑enabled grid display.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Provides Pomodoro and custom timers with session recording, streak and coin integration, and UI controls for timing workflows.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Renders a checkbox to mark a timetable entry as completed today and syncs status via backend calls.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog for editing a timetable entry’s title and activity type while showing read‑only schedule info.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Shows a dialog with the last six months of completion history for a timetable entry with stats and daily markers.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: Provides UI and logic for listing, adding, editing, deleting, and marking timetable entries done today.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Implements task management UI including creation, editing, completion toggling, deletion, and note linking.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyStudyTimeG: Displays a weekly study time bar chart aggregated from study session data with totals by type.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailySyllabusCheck: Tracks daily syllabus checkoff count from localStorage with a polling interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, stored identities, and auth client setup.
Custom hook for syncing state to localStorage with optional numeric clamping.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor methods for profiles, coins, backgrounds, and other user data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Centralized wrapper for toast and browser notifications with fallbacks and permission handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to user‑friendly messages with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/levelRanks.ts: Defines level rank constants and normalizes legacy rank values.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Helpers for formatting dates and checking if a timestamp corresponds to today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and maps timetable ticks to daily completion status for the last six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and persist or clear them across navigation.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyStudyGraph.ts: Generates 7‑day study data by aggregating completed sessions into daily totals for pomodoro, custom, and stopwatch types.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s current state, planned features, issues, image-update requirements, and architectural notes for ongoing development.
